decisive_items: areas of linear and crescentic hyperdensity
15 mm in width with a 13-mm midline shift
response.rationale: CT shows a layered hypodense crescentic extra-axial collection with mixed densities and mass effect, classic for chronic subdural hematoma; clinical timeline (31 days post-op) and nonpositional severe headache support chronicity. R2 is a broader subdural hematoma label but lacks the chronic qualifier.

rejected.why: Headache is nonpositional and unrelieved by rest/analgesics, and CT shows a significant extra-axial collection, not typical of post-dural puncture headache.
Epidural hematoma is typically biconvex and hyperacute; the crescentic layered hypodense pattern is more consistent with subdural, not epidural.
